# Mathematical formulas

A fraction $\frac{a+b}{c+d}$ and an exponent $x^2$ share the text baseline.

A soft wrap preserves $a +
b + c$ as one formula.

$$
\int_0^1 x^2\,dx = \frac{1}{3}
$$

$$\begin{pmatrix}a&b\\c&d\end{pmatrix}$$

| Name | Expression |
|------|------------|
| Sum | $\sum_{k=1}^{n} k$ |
| Root | $\sqrt{x}$ |

`$x^2$` stays literal.
